_about: teach what essences do, how catalogue items are made, and which properties exist —
the herbal and smithing manuals' counterpart (content/rules/herbal-manuals.json,
smithing-manuals.json). Read by rules/knowledge.py (`manual_keys`); sold through
Original writing for Pathfinder GM (2026-10-05). Prices are PROPOSED, in the other
manuals' range (6 to 15 gp) and dearer as the knowledge is rarer, as the deep-metals
book is: the owner tunes them in play.
`teaches` rows name one of: an `essence` by material id, with which of its traits the
book holds ("all", "benefits", "drawbacks", "working", or a list of trait keys:
`recipe` by catalogue id (the making of a wondrous item or ring); or a `property` by
the id in content/rules/magic-properties.json (or "enhancement"), the type Unbind
would teach. An id nothing holds is skipped, never invented.
